indication_tracked: Ogsiveo as monotherapy is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with progressing desmoid tumours who require systemic treatment.
indication_source: Therapeutic indication as published in EMA's medicines data (word for word)

eu.epar_summary:
Ogsiveo is a medicine used to treat adults with progressing desmoid tumours who need systemic treatment (medicines that travel through the bloodstream and affect the whole body).

Desmoid tumours develop from the soft, supporting tissues of the body. They can grow rapidly and damage nearby tissues and organs.

Progressing desmoid tumours are rare, and Ogsiveo was designated an ‘orphan medicine’ (a medicine used in rare diseases) on 17 October 2019.

Ogsiveo contains the active substance nirogacestat.
